from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import contextlib
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

OWN = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = OWN.parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / 'src'))
from tools import changed_unit_tests as graph
from tools import pre_push_gate as gate
from tools.pdf_runtime_probe import run_cold_probe as probe
from company_wiki._bounded_process import ChildTimeout
REPORTS = ROOT / 'docs/plans/du11-source-closure-2026-10-18/review/architecture-quality-20261101/implementation-results'
POLICY = json.loads((REPORTS / 'R7-CWP-CI-policy-test-consolidation.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
OBS = {}

def definitions(text):
    return {n.name: n for n in ast.parse(text).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name.startswith('test_')}

class Review(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_01_capability_map_covers_actual_old_definitions_and_destination_exists(self):
        old = set()
        current = {}
        for path in POLICY['delivery_files_sha256']:
            process = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(ROOT), 'show', POLICY['base_head'] + ':' + path],
                                     capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=10)
            old.update(path + '::' + name for name in definitions(process.stdout.decode('utf-8-sig')))
            if (ROOT / path).is_file():
                current.update(definitions((ROOT / path).read_text(encoding='utf-8')))
        table = POLICY['old_capability_destination']
        self.assertEqual(old, {row['old'] for row in table})
        for row in table:
            for name in re.findall(r'test_\w+', row['retained_at'].split('::')[-1]):
                self.assertIn(name, current)
        for name, node in current.items():
            self.assertFalse(any('skip' in ast.unparse(d) or 'xfail' in ast.unparse(d) for d in node.decorator_list), name)
        OBS['capability_map'] = {'old_top_level_test_definitions': len(old), 'rows': len(table), 'destinations_exist': True, 'no_skip_xfail': True}

    def test_02_real_collection_only_preserves106_unique_cases(self):
        targets = [p for p, digest in POLICY['delivery_files_sha256'].items() if digest is not None]
        environment = dict(os.environ, PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
                           PYTHONPATH=str(ROOT / 'src'), TEMP=str(OWN), TMP=str(OWN))
        process = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-B', '-X', 'utf8', '-m', 'pytest', '--collect-only',
                                 '-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '--basetemp', str(OWN / 'collect'), *targets],
                                cwd=ROOT, env=environment, capture_output=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=20)
        self.assertEqual(process.returncode, 0, process.stdout + process.stderr)
        self.assertIn('106 tests collected', process.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('test_daily_push_bounds.py::', process.stdout)
        self.assertNotIn('test_pre_push_parallel_phases.py::', process.stdout)
        OBS['collection_only'] = {'exit': 0, 'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr,
                                  'note': 'Collection only; none of106 cases or4Git E2Es executed.'}

    def test_03_daily_varied_ranges_only_one_child_no_dependency_graph(self):
        for changes, expected in (({'docs/guide.md'}, 0), ({'src/pkg/new.py'}, 1),
                                  ({'config/new.json'}, 1), ({'unexpected/startup.bin'}, 1), (None, 1)):
            with self.subTest(changes=changes), patch.object(gate.sys, 'stdin', io.StringIO('range')), \
                 patch.object(gate, 'changed_paths', return_value=changes), \
                 patch.object(graph, 'select_unit_tests', side_effect=AssertionError('AST on daily')), \
                 patch.object(gate, '_run_pytest_gate', return_value=31) as child, \
                 contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()) as out:
                self.assertEqual(gate.main(['--push-checks']), 31 if expected else 0)
                self.assertEqual(child.call_count, expected)
                self.assertNotIn('local_fast_pass', out.getvalue())
                if expected:
                    actual = [p for p in child.call_args.args[0] if p.startswith('tests/')]
                    self.assertEqual(actual, list(gate.DAILY_PUSH_CASES))
                else:
                    self.assertIn('tests_not_run', out.getvalue())

    def test_04_real_budgets_and_ci_ocr_inventory_remain(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(gate.DAILY_PUSH_CASES), 9)
        self.assertEqual(len(gate.CI_CONTRACT_CASES), 22)
        self.assertFalse(any(t.startswith('tests/unit/') for t in gate.CI_CONTRACT_CASES))
        ocr = [t for t in gate.CI_CONTRACT_CASES if t.startswith('tests/document_normalization/')]
        self.assertEqual(len(ocr), 6)
        for daily in (True, False):
            created = []
            def scratch(_roots):
                result = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='review-scratch-', dir=OWN)
                created.append(Path(result.name))
                return result
            with patch.object(gate, '_open_scratch', side_effect=scratch), \
                 patch.object(gate, '_run', return_value=17) as run:
                targets = list(gate.DAILY_PUSH_CASES) if daily else ['tests/unit']
                label = gate.DAILY_PUSH_LABEL_PREFIX + ' independent' if daily else 'unit tests'
                self.assertEqual(gate._run_pytest_gate([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', *targets], label), 17)
            run.assert_called_once()
            self.assertEqual(run.call_args.kwargs['timeout'], 180 if daily else 600)
            self.assertEqual('-n' in run.call_args.args[0], not daily)
            self.assertTrue(all(not p.exists() for p in created))
        OBS['inventory'] = {'daily': 9, 'ci_nonunit': 22, 'ocr_resource_cases': 6, 'timeouts': [180, 600]}

    def test_05_optional_analysis_and_git_union_are_independent(self):
        root = OWN / 'graph'
        for path, text in {'src/example/__init__.py': '', 'src/example/engine.py': 'value=1\n',
                           'src/example/view.py': 'from . import engine\n',
                           'tests/support/help.py': 'from example import view\n',
                           'tests/unit/test_view.py': 'from support import help\n',
                           'tests/unit/test_other.py': 'def test_other(): pass\n'}.items():
            target = root / path
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
        selected, _reason = graph.select_unit_tests(root, {'src/example/engine.py'})
        self.assertEqual(selected, ['tests/unit/test_view.py'])
        self.assertEqual(graph.select_unit_tests(root, {'config/new.json'})[0], ['tests/unit'])
        first = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, 'src/before.py\nsrc/after.py\n', '')
        second = subprocess.CompletedProcess([], 0, 'tests/unit/test_view.py\n', '')
        rows = 'a ' + 'a'*64 + ' b ' + 'b'*64 + '\nc ' + 'c'*40 + ' d ' + 'd'*40
        with patch.object(graph.subprocess, 'run', side_effect=[first, second]) as git:
            self.assertEqual(graph.changed_paths(root, rows), {'src/before.py', 'src/after.py', 'tests/unit/test_view.py'})
        self.assertEqual(git.call_count, 2)

    def test_06_actual_missing_runner_hook_is_red(self):
        hooks = OWN / 'missing/.githooks'
        hooks.mkdir(parents=True)
        target = hooks / 'pre-push'
        shutil.copyfile(ROOT / '.githooks/pre-push', target)
        process = subprocess.run(['C:/Program Files/Git/bin/sh.exe', str(target)],
                                 capture_output=True, encoding='utf-8', timeout=10)
        self.assertNotEqual(process.returncode, 0)
        self.assertIn('missing', (process.stdout + process.stderr).lower())
        OBS['missing_hook'] = {'exit': process.returncode, 'stdout': process.stdout, 'stderr': process.stderr}

    def test_07_cold_timeout_then_new_explicit_request_keeps_every_old_file(self):
        root = OWN / 'cold'
        receipts = root / 'receipts'
        receipts.mkdir(parents=True)
        archived = {'cold-rev5.marker.json': b'old-root-marker', 'cold-rev5.json': b'old-root-receipt',
                    'cold-rev5-prior/cold-rev5.json': b'old-attempt-receipt'}
        for name, value in archived.items():
            target = receipts / name
            target.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            target.write_bytes(value)
        profile = root / 'independent-profile.json'
        config = {'python': sys.executable, 'artifacts': [], 'max_memory_bytes': 123456789,
                  'environment_sha256': 'b'*64, 'docling_version': 'synthetic-no-sdk'}
        profile.write_text(json.dumps(config), encoding='utf-8')
        calls = []
        def child(_command, **kwargs):
            request = json.loads(kwargs['input_bytes'])
            calls.append({'timeout': kwargs['timeout_seconds'], 'stdout_cap': kwargs['stdout_cap_bytes'],
                          'stderr_cap': kwargs['stderr_cap_bytes'], 'request': request})
            Path(request['temp'], 'own.txt').write_text('child scratch', encoding='utf-8')
            if len(calls) == 1:
                failure = ChildTimeout('synthetic deadline')
                failure.stdout = b'{"stage":"START"}\n'
                failure.stderr = b'bounded failure'
                raise failure
            return {'stdout': b'{"stage":"DONE","active":"DONE_NO_DOCUMENT"}\n', 'stderr': b''}
        original = probe.tempfile.mkdtemp
        def own_temp(*args, **kwargs):
            if kwargs.get('dir') is None:
                kwargs['dir'] = root
            return original(*args, **kwargs)
        argv = [str(probe.__file__), '--profile', str(profile), '--receipts-dir', str(receipts), '--deadline', '.02']
        with patch.object(sys, 'argv', argv), patch.object(probe, 'run_bounded', side_effect=child), \
             patch.object(probe, 'child_launch_command', return_value=[sys.executable, str(probe.__file__)]), \
             patch.object(probe, 'child_environment', return_value={}), \
             patch.object(probe.tempfile, 'mkdtemp', side_effect=own_temp), contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
            probe.main()
            probe.main()
        observed = [json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) for p in receipts.glob('cold-rev5-*/cold-rev5.json')
                    if p.parent.name != 'cold-rev5-prior']
        self.assertEqual(len(observed), 2)
        self.assertEqual({o['status'] for o in observed}, {'ChildTimeout', 'completed'})
        self.assertEqual(sum(o['done_no_document'] for o in observed), 1)
        self.assertTrue(all(o['scratch_restored_absent'] for o in observed))
        self.assertTrue(all(o['profile_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(profile.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for o in observed))
        self.assertTrue(all(o['profile_relative'].endswith('independent-profile.json') for o in observed))
        for call in calls:
            self.assertEqual((call['timeout'], call['stdout_cap'], call['stderr_cap']), (.02, 2*1024*1024, 65536))
            self.assertEqual(call['request']['cpu_threads'], 4)
            self.assertEqual(call['request']['document_timeout'], 120)
            self.assertEqual(call['request']['max_memory_bytes'], config['max_memory_bytes'])
            self.assertFalse(Path(call['request']['temp']).exists())
        for name, value in archived.items():
            self.assertEqual((receipts / name).read_bytes(), value)
        OBS['cold'] = {'calls': calls, 'receipts': observed, 'old_files_preserved': list(archived),
                       'fresh_attempts': 2, 'sdk_calls': 0}

if __name__ == '__main__':
    result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromTestCase(Review))
    (OWN / 'observations.json').write_text(json.dumps(OBS, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
